description: This file defines the Startup class within the Opencart admin marketplace controller namespace. It manages startup-related functionalities such as listing, enabling/disabling, and deleting startup entries, typically used within the admin panel of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: A controller class to manage startup entries in the Opencart admin marketplace module, providing functions such as listing, enabling, disabling, and deleting startup items.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to render the startup management page with data including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and startup list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to refresh the startup list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves startup entries with pagination and renders the startup list view.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected startup entries, checking permissions and returning JSON success or error message.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected startup entries, checking permissions and returning JSON success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected startup entries, checking permissions, and returning JSON response.
